checklist.message: Publish the source on GitHub and set repository in the manifest.
List the plugin in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json so Claude Code can install it from the repository.
List the plugin in .agents/plugins/marketplace.json so Codex can install it from the repository.
Publish MCP servers to the MCP Registry with server.json (https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry).
Connect the repository on HOL to verify ownership and claim the listing.
